title: Student AI Study - Smooth Female Voice Edit
strategy: Avoid black pauses by keeping every visual segment under the 5.04s source clip length. Avoid the scene-2 cropped feeling by shortening its visual hold. Use a calmer female educator voice and short scene voiceovers with small J/L-cut offsets.

scenes.voiceover_text: Stuck on a textbook page? Show AI the page.
Then give it context: your class, topic, and exact doubt.
Ask for simple steps, one example, and a question.
Do not copy answers. Use hints, quizzes, and feedback.
Best setup: AI helps, you practice, teacher verifies.
